name: Europa Metals Limited
source: Europa Metals Ltd audited consolidated annual report for the year ended 30 June 2026 (https://www.europametals.com/europa/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Europa-Metals-Ltd-Annual-Report-30-June-2026.pdf), consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, report page 17. Figures in Australian dollars (AUD). The group is a cash shell after the sale of the Toral project in November 2024: the statement presents no revenue line, so Revenue is nil in both years, and it presents no cost of sales line, so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are not reported and their previous rows were withdrawn because they contradicted a nil revenue line. FY2026 Operating Expenses 891,093 and FY2025 991,444 are administration expenses, note 3(b). FY2026 Operating Profit (EBIT) -876,493 is other income 14,600 less administration expenses; FY2025 4,584,281 is other gains 5,575,725 less administration expenses 991,444. The fixed label set has no row for fair value gains and losses on financial assets, gains and losses on disposal of financial assets, or foreign exchange, and those three items reconcile EBIT to profit before tax exactly in both years: FY2026 -876,493 plus 189,981 plus 415,054 less 128,071 equals -399,529; FY2025 4,584,281 less 1,195,954 less 236,580 less 16,597 equals 3,135,150. Income tax is nil in both years. EPS is the basic loss and profit per share printed in cents, converted to dollars, before the 12 for 1 share consolidation that took effect on 21 September 2026: FY2026 -0.39 cents, FY2025 3.19 cents. Read 2026-11-11.
